_about: The answers store's cap, ONE rule in two implementations: deploy/scenario_store.py cap_answers + merge_answers (tests/test_scenario_store.py) and app/src/lib/answers.ts capAnswers + upsertAnswers (answers.test.ts) both run every case here. Rule: only one-off (txn-scope) answers count toward the limit and only they are dropped, the oldest answered_at first, then by key, until no more than `limit` of them are left; vendor-scope answers are never dropped; strings compare by code unit. Synthetic data only.

cap_cases.name: a vendor answer is never dropped, however old: past the limit only the oldest one-off answer goes
vendor answers do not count toward the limit: one-off answers within it keep everything
only vendor answers, far past the limit: nothing goes
a stamp tie goes by key in plain code-unit order ('B' < 'a' < 'b'), never locale order
stamps compare as strings, as the store compares them: '...:00Z' sorts after '...:00.500Z'
at the limit (one-off answers only) nothing goes

bulk_about: Each bulk case's answers are built by one rule on both sides (bulk_answers in tests/test_scenario_store.py, bulkAnswers in answers.test.ts): `vendor` vendor-scope answers first, keys 'vendor:Synthetic Vendor 0000' up, then `txn` one-off answers, keys 'txn:t0000' up; every set is {"tags": ["x"]}; the n-th answer built (from 0) is stamped 2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z plus n seconds, so every vendor answer is older than every one-off one. `limit` is MAX_ANSWERS; `evicted` lists exactly the keys the cap drops.

bulk_cases.name: 600 vendor answers + 10 one-off answers: nothing goes
400 vendor answers + 520 one-off answers: the 20 oldest one-off answers go, every vendor answer stays

full_store._about: 2 vendor answers (the oldest answer stored is vendor-scope) + MAX_ANSWERS (500) one-off answers stored, then one new one-off answer: the oldest one-off answer goes, every vendor answer stays
